data.name: A Helping Hand
data.description: Complete 50 favors at the seasonal altar.

data.name: Adept
data.description: Your journey continues as you grow in strength. Reach level 25 and become a true adept.

data.name: Alchemist
data.description: From vial to flask to splash: brew small health potions, minor health potions, and health splash potions to prove your mastery of the healing arts.

data.name: Amateur Lumberjack
data.description: Ash wood is the first step to mastery. Gather 6 000 ash woods and begin your lumberjack career.

data.name: Amateur Miner
data.description: Copper glimmers in the veins of the earth. Gather 6 000 copper ores and begin your mining journey.

data.name: Bite! Oh, algae!
data.description: Sometimes, all you catch is algae. Gather 2 500 algaes and embrace the surprises of fishing.

data.name: Cabinet Maker
data.description: Master cabinetry requires variety: craft hardwood, spruce, and dead wood planks to prove your woodworking expertise.

data.name: Expert Fisherman
data.description: The elusive bass is the pride of expert anglers. Gather 6 000 bass.

data.name: Expert Lumberjack
data.description: Dead wood holds secrets of the forest. Gather 6 000 dead woods and prove your expertise.

data.name: Feather Me Impressed
data.description: The legend of the endless flock beckons. Prove your might (and appetite) by slaughtering 1 000 chickens.

data.name: Highway Patrol
data.description: No traveler is safe while highwaymen lurk. Patrol the roads and defeat 1 000 Highwaymen.

data.name: I want bacon!
data.description: The farms overflow with squealing pigs. Satisfy your hunger for glory (and bacon) by slaughtering 1 000 pigs.

data.name: In every color
data.description: Slimes splash every hue across the forest. Hunt 50 of each color to restore the forest's balance.

data.name: Intermediate Fisherman
data.description: The swift trout challenges all but the best. Gather 6 000 trouts and rise in the ranks.

data.name: Intermediate Lumberjack
data.description: Birch trees test your skill. Gather 6 000 birch woods to master your craft.

data.name: Intermediate Miner
data.description: Coal fuels progress. Gather 6 000 coals and power the world.

data.name: King of the Forest
data.description: The forest crowns those who master its hunters. Fell wolves, flying snakes, and mushmush to claim the title of King of the Forest.

data.name: Lumberjack
data.description: Spruce forests echo with the sound of axes. Gather 6 000 spruce woods and earn the title of Lumberjack.

data.name: Miner
data.description: Iron shapes kingdoms. Gather 6 000 iron ores to build your legacy.

data.name: Novice
data.description: Every hero starts somewhere. Reach level 10 and step onto the path of adventure.

data.name: Slimed to None
data.description: A monstrous slime crowned in the forest. Prove your worth by defeating the King Slime.

data.name: Tanner's Exchange
data.description: The tailor offers a precious trade: exchange your hides for fine leather. Buy 25 Hard Leather and 25 Snakeskin to the tailor.

data.name: Worker
data.description: From raw ore to refined metal: forge iron bars, steel bars, and gold bars to prove your worth as a skilled worker.
